# SPD-053 — PR landing: the auto-mode permission classifier refuses Spud's gh pr merge (Merge Without Review), so Eric merges by hand

## Brief
Eric's standing call (2026-09-14, SPD-014 question 3) is that Spud merges a PR-landing project's pull request himself once the required checks pass. On BAD-001 (PR https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/329) the auto-mode permission classifier refused Spud's `gh pr merge` as "Merge Without Review", and Eric merged by hand.

Find what makes the merge allowed without weakening review in general: an allow rule `project install` writes into the project's untracked settings (for example `Bash(gh pr merge *)`), GitHub auto-merge enabled by Spud when the PR opens, or another sanctioned route; and whether the classifier respects any of them. If none is acceptable, the landing step in CLAUDE.md says Eric merges and Spud records the ticket done after the merge.

Done when: a BadTakes PR with green checks lands without Eric's hand, or CLAUDE.md and the merge memory say plainly that Eric merges.

## Size, persona and model decision
A researcher on opus (no Fable today) to find the sanctioned way to let Spud merge a PR with green checks, or to record that Eric merges; then an engineer or a CLAUDE.md edit.
